cases.name: Free frame, two-mass spring, one positive pole

configuration.source:
! Independent mechanics check, not an archived ASWING validation case.
! Select ASWING moving-frame vacuum modes, free frame, zero gravity.
! EA/L = 100 N/m, endpoint masses 2 and 3 kg.
! The axial angular frequency is sqrt(100*(1/2+1/3)) rad/s.
! Request one mode near shift (-0.1, 9.128709291752768).
! Global rigid-body zero/Jordan chains are retained but not selected here.
Name
Free-frame axial oscillator
End
Unit
L 1 m
T 1 s
F 1 N
End
Constant
10 1.225 340
End
Reference
2 .2 2
End
Ground
1 1 0
End
Weight
1 1 0 0 0 20 0 0 0 0 0 10 15 20 0 0 0
1 3 0 2 0 30 0 0 0 0 0 12 18 24 0 0 0
End
Beam 1
Massless axial spring
t x y z chord
1 0 0 0 .2
3 0 2 0 .2
t EA EIcc GJ EInn GKc GKn
1 200 0 0 0 0 0
3 200 0 0 0 0 0
End

mesh_discretization.coordinates: Undeformed material arc length; theta decreases from pi to zero. Rigid position jumps contain no beam material.

mass_properties.scope: Mass and first moment describe the source gravity rule. Dynamic inertia uses the endpoint-product descriptor operator, including section and point inertia. No single symmetric aggregate spatial tensor is asserted for this finite-difference rule.

elements.frame_role: geometric display only; use transform_average for constitutive components
geometric display only; use transform_average for constitutive components
geometric display only; use transform_average for constitutive components
geometric display only; use transform_average for constitutive components

structure.sample_location: element constitutive average; t is its material-midpoint plot coordinate
structure.shell_sampling: Inward endpoint properties averaged before interval strain/stress recovery; endpoint_traces use exact sided properties.
structure.peak_sampling: Interval estimates and both endpoint traces; no extrapolation through load or property jumps.
limitations: Interval local components use the arithmetic endpoint transform average, not the orthonormal physical midpoint display frame.
Interval strain follows the selected averaged stiffness/force law. Averaged shell properties give a constitutive interval estimate, not a point sample or an average of endpoint stress.
Endpoint strains use one-sided section properties and conservative endpoint resultants. Both sides of load/property jumps remain distinct.
Shell coordinates are measured from the tension axis per steady Eq.28. Exact historical ASWING output sampling remains unverified.

Closed-shell torsional shear uses translated Mprime_s/(2*Atshell). Missing shell arms or nonpositive area leave unavailable values null; strength, warping and transverse-shear stresses are not inferred.
Loaded base state for the frozen continuous-time modal linearization.
The averaged transform is generally not a rotation. Element local components use transform_average; the physical midpoint frame is for geometric display only.

Eq. 54 uses inverse averaged bending/torsion stiffness. EA, GK and offsets are averaged before applying Eqs. 18–19; ds is unloaded arc. These property/length interpretations are not proven historical executable conventions.
Element constitutive estimates use averaged shell properties. Endpoint traces and sensor strains use their one-sided section properties; exact ASWING output sampling remains unverified.

Distributed loads average completed endpoint products and transfer each interval wrench symmetrically. Section rotary inertia includes steady Eq.80 exactly once, using unloaded interval length. For varying properties this finite-difference mass operator need not be symmetric; it is not a finite-element kinetic-energy mass matrix. Historical executable discretization and modal reference agreement remain unverified.

Angular inertia includes Omega cross omega from inertial differentiation of angular momentum; printed unsteady Eqs.40/47 omit this term. Global loads use the same symmetric interval transfer as local equilibrium (Eq.266). This explicitly declared interpretation is not established historical ASWING executable parity.

output_scope.authoritative: Nodes, reactions, source constitutive element estimates, one-sided endpoint resultants/section recovery and sensor-anchor sections.
output_scope.element_coordinates: t locates the interval on plots; interval strains use the source averaged law. endpoint_traces contain actual sided point samples.
output_scope.strain_components: source_discrete_elements.axial_strain is reference-axis epsilon_s; elements.axial_strain_tension is Fs/EA. Closed-shell shear uses the translated elastic-axis torque.

limitations: Sensor axes and locations follow their rigid pylons. Relative body position/velocity describe the beam anchor; GPS and inertial measurements describe the pylon tip.
Structural loads and strain use the inward endpoint and left trace at an interior sensor anchor, each in its actual one-sided section frame. Both adjacent traces remain available.
Shell strain/stress use the selected one-sided properties at the sensor anchor, not an adjacent element average. Exact historical ASWING trace choice at jumps remains unverified.
Vacuum modal analysis has no airflow; flow quantities remain unavailable.
Zero airspeed makes flow angles undefined. At a vertical sensor V axis, bank/heading are undefined; Euler-angle branches are not a global attitude representation.

equilibrium_state.units: Physical quantities in ASW input units; spatial rotation vectors in radians. Numerical solver scales are not stored.
limitations: This is a steady state. It contains no unsteady history or derivative state.
The source and mesh must match. Steady reuse corrects the full equilibrium; time launch validates the saved setup at zero local rates.
Local correction does not prove that a nonlinear branch is unique or that a fold has been followed.

biorthogonality.scope: Returned vectors only; no complete-spectrum or generalized-chain claim.

inverse_iteration.normalization: Divide by conjugate(wprime^H M v), enforcing Eq152.

diagnostics.spectrum_scope: Local full-descriptor Arnoldi search; total finite dimension unclassified.

integrator_deflation.criterion: Not applied: full descriptor retained for the published shifted Arnoldi operator.

diagnostics.left_recovery: ASWING Eq150 inverse iteration with reused sparse LU; explicit original-pencil Schur/null-space fallback for singular, unresolved or repeated poles; Eq152 selected-space pairing

derivative_linearization.method: physical load coefficient extraction and chain rule
derivative_linearization.hinge_derivative: analytic Jangle slope and SO(3) logarithm derivative
derivative_linearization.interpretation: Kinematic and controller-rate identities are exact. Fixed-state loads and measurements are at most quadratic in derivatives; symmetric physical probes extract their linear coefficient. No inertia threshold or matrix-entry snapping is applied.

diagnostics.normalization: Right vector pivot is real and one in scaled state coordinates. When possible, left^H M right = 1 with physical input-time M.
diagnostics.equation: M dz/dt = A z; eigenvalues have units 1/input T; time and frequency use the ASW input time unit.

node_coordinates.order: interleaved body translation / L and spatial rotation in radians

discretization.convention: Material arc coordinate s in [-L/2,L/2]; theta=acos(2*arc/L-1), decreasing pi to zero. Gamma=sum A_k sin(k theta). Weighted residual=(2/pi) sum R_i sin(k theta_i) delta_theta_i.
discretization.scope: Fourier modes are per logical lifting beam; refine mode count and structural intervals independently. Local flow defects need not vanish in a truncated series.

material_damping.note: A constitutive diagnostic only: aeroelastic stability and passivity of the full discretization are not established.

limitations: Vacuum eigenmodes of the source endpoint-average operator with moving-frame real inertia. Historical ASWING discrete/executable parity remains unverified.
Coefficients are frozen at the loaded base pose and motion. A rotating or accelerating trajectory can change these coefficients; local poles do not establish stability of that full trajectory.

The reduced methods classify algebraic and differentiated constraints numerically. Full-descriptor Arnoldi retains them in a local search and leaves the total finite dimension unclassified. Check mesh, difference step, rank and nearby shifts; eigenpair residuals alone do not prove physical accuracy.

The published strain-rate law can produce finite relaxation poles, including in zero-compliance directions and massless elements. Poles near -1/damping_time are labeled, not silently removed. Source rates use unsteady Eq.60 and full Eq.62 with local-axis Eq.57 damping; endpoint time averaging and exact historical implementation remain unverified. Damped sensor strains are sided interval estimates, not pointwise anchor samples.
Eigenvector magnitude and phase are arbitrary. Output geometry and loads are linear perturbations about the loaded base, not a finite-amplitude nonlinear simulation.
Repeated or defective zero modes may not admit individual left/right mass normalization; those pairs are marked. Mode truncation and ROM validity are not established.

Full-pencil Arnoldi applies no integrator deflation and certifies no exact zero multiplicity. Small computed roots are not snapped to zero; the near-neutral display threshold is not an eigenvalue error bound. General Jordan chains are not constructed. Left inverse-iteration failures and repeated-pole recovery are reported explicitly.

Fixed frame omits aircraft perturbations; prescribed, free and mixed frames retain all twelve frame kinematic states. Canonical net-load targets determine selected frame accelerations from the same nodal wrenches.

Controllers, aerodynamic apparent mass and flow coupling are outside this bounded policy. Endpoint-averaged inertia is a finite-difference operator, not a conventional symmetric finite-element mass matrix; variable properties need separate consistency checks.

Angular inertia uses alpha_o + omega_dot + Omega cross omega from Earth-frame angular momentum. The transport term is absent from printed Eqs.40/47; this physical interpretation is explicit, not verified historical code parity.

fields.label: Normal distributed inertial load per length

sampling.nodes: Material node; rotations are spatial increments about the loaded base, with zero base value.
sampling.sections: Constitutive material midpoint, local c/s/n axes; no interpolation across load or property jumps.
sampling.strips: Aerodynamic strip sample; force and moment vectors use body axes. Densities retain the current-length normalization.
sampling.global: Global report quantity; force and moment vectors use body axes and the file moment reference.
